version: HarmonyBot V74 Run63 Early First-Passage Result
diagnosis: Early 0.25R/0.50R observation removes the N ceiling but old frontier cannot jointly preserve winner size and convert enough reactions into wins. Threshold/classifier tuning is not the primary fix.

label_only_forensic.rule: Future outcomes used only to test feasibility, never selection.
label_only_forensic.result: A runner-preserving positive-floor barbell has oracle top-250 solutions satisfying all fixed V74 metrics in each burned year, so payoff support exists and exit/payoff reconstruction remains falsifiable.
